summary: PowerCompute, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a bridge loan agreement. Its subsidiary borrowed $18 million from ChainFi Inc. (Arch Lending) via two promissory notes to repay existing debt to Galaxy Digital and DE AJ Liebel, pending a secured term loan facility collateralized by Bitcoin. A third amendment extended a $1.125 million loan from Brown Family Enterprises to December 31, 2026. This is routine financing activity, not a special situation. Terms include a maturity date of July 31, 2026, interest at the Applicable Federal Rate, and a 15% default rate. Watch for execution of the term loan facility.
